draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.15, the 111th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 10th of 23 at DT. He went 89th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2 sacks in 2022, 13th of 23 DTs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Rams. 51 career games and 37 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (10 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 10 (97th percentile), sacks 7.0 (96th percentile), tackles for loss 9 (94th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 interior lineman who played: 20 pressures against a median of 4, above the norm.
